semantics.compaction_events_observed: how many NEW compaction generations began, i.e. transitions where the contract-stripped summary changed. This is the authoritative observable for a new compaction.
semantics.distinct_compaction_generations: how many distinct compaction GENERATIONS existed. The generation identity is computed on the CONTRACT-STRIPPED summary, so an enriched projection of an existing generation is the SAME generation, not a new one.
semantics.distinct_provider_visible_summary_payloa: how many distinct provider-visible summary payloads existed. This counts the enriched projections as separate payloads.
semantics.distinct_summary_generations: how many distinct summary payloads existed over the run
semantics.generation_transformations_observed: how many times an existing generation was merely TRANSFORMED (the task-contract section was appended). These are NOT compaction events.
semantics.requests_with_compacted_summary: how many provider requests carried a compacted summary -- a STATE count, NOT a count of compaction events
